findings.element: Overview right after Finish setup — Sync block Enable (narrow left column) vs store card "Ready" + Map products (wide right card)
findings.finding: Once onboarding finishes, the only lasting cue that sync is still off is "State: Disabled" plus Enable in the narrow side block under four empty "–" tiles, while the wide store card says "Ready" and its only button is Map products.
findings.user_impact: When the toast disappears, users can read "Ready" as "done" or go to Map products as the next step, and never press Enable. This is the KF-2 "I thought it was already done" drop-off.
findings.suggested_fix: Show a persistent "Sync is off — Enable to start sending stock changes" prompt with Enable next to the ready store (or at the top of the Overview) until sync is enabled, and keep Map products visually secondary to it.

evidence.action: Completed onboarding (Open Settings → choose Warehouse in California → Finish setup) and looked at the Overview
evidence.observed: A transient toast says "My ceramic plates is ready. Click Enable to start sending stock changes." After it, the page shows tiles "Held – Failed – Pending – Applied in 24h –" at top-left of b-sync (254,381 382x166) with "State: Disabled / Enable". stores-card (652,381 764x634) shows "My ceramic plates — Ready … 1 item needs mapping … Map products".

findings.element: 2-step onboarding steps vs store card "Setup needed" checklist (My good flowers)
findings.finding: The first store's onboarding orders setup as "1 Enable inventory tracking, 2 Choose location". The checklist on a later store's card orders the same steps the other way and names them differently ("1 Choose location, 2 Set Created product to Inventory, 3 1 item needs mapping").
findings.user_impact: When users prepare their second and third stores, they have to relearn a sequence they just finished, and they can't tell whether "Enable inventory tracking" and "Set Created product to Inventory" are the same task. This slows or confuses the multi-store part of the primary task.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one step order and the same step labels in the onboarding and on the store card checklist.

findings.element: Stock check tab — Latest comparison meta line and empty table in State 3
findings.finding: The Overview flags My good flowers' failed nightly check with an error line and its own Compare now. On the differences page, that failure appears only as plain text inside the meta line ("My good flowers: failed Oct 2, 2026 02:30"), and the table directly below says "No unresolved differences."
findings.user_impact: People who open the differences page to confirm stock matches see "No unresolved differences" and may decide every store is fine, even though one store wasn't compared at all.
findings.suggested_fix: On the differences page, show the failed store as an error notice above the table and say in the empty state that it covers only the stores that were compared, with Compare now for the failed store.

evidence.action: Opened State 3, then the Stock check tab
evidence.observed: Overview block: "error The last check of My good flowers failed (Oct 2, 2026 02:30), so its stock wasn't compared. Compare now". Differences page: "Latest comparison · My ceramic plates: Oct 2, 2026 02:30 · My good flowers: failed Oct 2, 2026 02:30" with no error glyph, then the table "No unresolved differences."

findings.finding: "Previous comparisons" lists the latest comparison as well (Oct 2, 2026 02:30, My ceramic plates), which is the same one the main table already shows as "Latest comparison". So one set of rows can be reached and acted on from two places.
findings.user_impact: Users can't tell which comparisons are actually older, and they may review or resolve the same differences twice through View rows.
findings.suggested_fix: Leave the comparison shown as "Latest" out of "Previous comparisons", or label that row in the list as Latest.

gaps: Onboarding step 1: nobody clicked the collapsed step 2 row ("2 Choose location"), so it's unknown whether the numbered row looks clickable but does nothing (KF-4).

Connect store on a Not connected card (My good flowers / Seasonal pop-up) after the first store was ready was never tried, so it's unknown whether later stores get the 2-step onboarding or the card checklist.
Differences page Compare now was never clicked, so it's unknown whether it re-runs the failed store, all stores, or only the filtered store, and what loading or result state follows.

After the bulk Update Shopify qty, the table showed "No unresolved differences.", but the state map doesn't say whether Unresolved only was on at that moment. It's unknown whether updated rows show an Updated/Sending status anywhere or simply disappear, and the toast is future tense ("will be updated").
Row-level Ignore and bulk Ignore were never confirmed, so the outcome and how to reverse it are unknown.
There are no Failed sample events and Run now only shows a toast, so the Failed tile path and its error state can't be checked.
Clicking a tile whose count is 0 (Failed 0, which still shows a chevron) was never tried, so the empty-result state is unknown.
